# Blossom Therapy

> Attachment-focused individual and couples therapy in Nashville, TN with Marcia Truitt, AMFT. Heal. Grow. Blossom. Through Authentic Attachment.

- Services: individual therapy ($140 per 50-minute clinical hour) and couples therapy ($180 per 50-minute clinical hour). Private pay only; insurance is not accepted. A limited number of reduced-rate sessions are available based on need.
- Clinical specialties: grief and loss, anxiety, depression, unprocessed trauma, relationship conflict and disconnection, difficult life transitions, perfectionism and self-criticism, dysfunctional family systems.
- Approach: rooted in attachment science; integrates Emotionally Focused Therapy (individuals and couples), Cognitive Behavioral Therapy, and Solution Focused Therapy; EMDR training in process.
- Hours: Tuesdays 9–4 (virtual only), Wednesdays 12–7, Thursdays 10–5 (in office or virtual). Sessions are by appointment only.
- Location: Midtown Therapy Space, 210 25th Ave N. Suite 700, Nashville, TN 37203. Wheelchair accessible; free parking in the building garage.
- Contact: inquiry form at https://healgrowblossomtherapy.com/#contact — includes a free 15-minute consultation to assess fit.
- Therapist: Marcia Truitt, AMFT. Member of the American Association for Marriage and Family Therapy. Under the clinical supervision of Courtney Nash (License #2350).
